guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice shows the largest anomalies in the digest (latency-90 +16752%, z=+358.9; socket count 3 to 6.65, z=+24.4; mem roughly doubled), and checkoutservice, its only caller, logs 33 'failed to send order confirmation ... no healthy upstream' warnings with its own latency-90 doubling. Socket is chosen over mem and delay because socket and mem rise together and the 'no healthy upstream' errors suggest connection-level failure, but the digest cannot cleanly separate socket from mem or delay, so confidence is medium.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or reschedule the emailservice pods to clear the connection and memory buildup. Then inspect emailservice connection handling and health checks and confirm that checkoutservice order-confirmation calls recover.
